scope: Official IDX current company-profile directory snapshot; capability and comparison evidence only
what_is_proven: The ordinary public official IDX current-directory response is structurally valid and exposes 962 unique current issuer codes.
The new current-directory response exactly matches the prior official current snapshot by code and listing date, providing an independently rechecked current-snapshot surface.
The official current codes are a subset of the 980-code anchor surface; CNTX and 17 other anchor-only codes are not current-directory records.
The six current official codes absent from the newer public EOD snapshot have July 7-10, 2026 listing dates, supporting a bounded snapshot-timing explanation for that gap.
what_remains_unknown: daily historical membership and population completeness
survivorship, delisting, relisting, and ticker-reuse semantics
publication or available-at time and revision/vintage behavior

admission.allowed_use: current directory identity cross-check and bounded acquisition design only
admission.forbidden_use: historical PIT universe substitution, survivorship certification, canonical backfill, or predictive admission

reopen_trigger: A population-wide daily PIT/lifecycle contract with issuer/ISIN continuity, publication/knowledge time, revisions, and corporate-action basis semantics.
